description: This Java interface defines configuration methods for signal enrichment, including cache settings, timeout durations, and rendering to a Config object within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: GatewaySignalEnrichmentConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying configuration retrieval methods for signal enrichment, such as cache usage, timeout durations, and config rendering. Also includes an enum for default config values.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for cache retrievals.

methods.name: isCachingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether caching is enabled for signal enrichment.

methods.name: getCacheConfig
methods.description: Provides the cache configuration applicable to signal enrichment caches.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the configuration as a Config object.
